name: Content Revenue Engine
author: leadhospitality

sections.description:
Content Revenue Engine is a monetization plugin for WordPress designed for publishers, premium blogs, media sites, membership-driven content businesses, and knowledge brands that want a stronger revenue model than a simple paywall.

With CRE Free you can combine:
* Metered paywall rules
* Pay Per Post monetization
* Stripe and PayPal payments
* Sales tracking
* Conversion-focused CTA and notices
* Paywall exemptions and content rules

CRE Free includes:
* Metered paywall
* One Pay Per Post category
* One default PPP price
* Stripe and PayPal for PPP
* Dashboard, Inspector, and Sales
* Upgrade path to PRO for advanced PPP and monetization controls

PRO expands the monetization engine with advanced Pay Per Post controls such as unlimited paid categories, different prices by category, paid tags, paid posts individually, post-level pricing, and more growth-oriented monetization workflows.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/content-revenue-engine directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ContentRevenue in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your paywall, Pay Per Post, and payment settings.
sections.faq:
What can I monetize with CRE Free?

You can use a metered paywall and one Pay Per Post category with one default price.

Does CRE Free support Stripe and PayPal?

Yes. CRE Free supports Stripe and PayPal for Pay Per Post.

Does CRE Free include subscriptions?

No. Access+ subscriptions are part of the PRO ecosystem.

What does PRO add?

PRO adds advanced Pay Per Post controls such as unlimited paid categories, different prices by category, paid tags, paid posts individually, post-level pricing, and additional monetization tools.
